app.name: Metra
app.descriptor: Project and cost control for interior-design studios

home.title: Metra
home.tagline: Project and cost control for interior-design studios
home.intro: Every pound of a project's value, traceable from the line you quoted to the line you invoiced.

seo.title: Project & cost control for interior-design studios
seo.description: Metra runs interior-design studios through every stage of a fit-out (proposals, approvals, payment gates, and handoff) with every pound traceable from quote to invoice. Bilingual and EGP-native.

hero.headline: Every interior project, from concept to <accent>handoff</accent>, under control.
hero.lede: Metra runs your studio through each stage of a fit-out (proposals, design approvals, payment gates, and handoff) while keeping every pound traceable from the line you quoted to the line you invoiced.
hero.note: No credit card · Arabic & English · set up in minutes

trust.line: Built for interior-design and fit-out studios: bilingual, EGP-native, and made for how the region actually works.

problem.title: Great design, leaking margins.
problem.lede: Interior projects lose money in the gaps: between the quote and the invoice, the concept and the sign-off, the site and the schedule. Spreadsheets and chat threads can't hold a whole fit-out together.
problem.value1Desc: every project moves through the same clear stages, so nothing stalls unseen.
problem.value2Title: Money in view the whole way:
problem.value2Desc: quote-to-invoice traceability and live margin on every job.
problem.value3Title: Client sign-offs that gate the work:
problem.value3Desc: approvals and payments unlock the next phase, on the record.
problem.cardCaption: Revised contract value, tracked against billed-to-date, to four decimals.

features.title: Everything a studio needs to run a fit-out.
features.subtitle: From the first proposal to the final handoff: one system, built for interior work.
features.flowDesc: Lead → concept → design approval → payment gates → handoff. Every project follows the same clear path, so you always know exactly where each one stands.
features.costDesc: Every line is traceable from the quote you sent to the invoice you raised. See your true margin on each project in real time, with no surprises at closeout.
features.proposalsDesc: Send client-ready proposals, collect sign-offs, and tie payment gates to each stage, so the design only advances when the client and the money say go.
features.bilingualDesc: Full right-to-left Arabic and English, EGP-native figures, and a bilingual client experience, not an afterthought bolted on the end.

shots.flow: A delivery's page in Metra: the stage track at 3D designs, waiting on the client, with the Gate B payment due
shots.cost: The proposal builder: quantity, unit cost and unit price on every line, with the total cost and margin under them
shots.proposals: The client's page: the final design ready to approve, with its renders, under the studio's bar
shots.bilingualAr: The client's budget and payments, in Arabic

how.title: Four stages, start to finish.
how.subtitle: The same rhythm on every project, so your team, and your client, always know what's next.
how.step1Desc: Build the proposal from your price book, send it, and collect the signing deposit.
how.step2Desc: Share concepts and renders; the client selects and signs off at each gate.
how.step3Desc: Payment gates unlock the next phase; scope changes become priced variations.
how.step4Desc: Reconcile as-built against contract, settle the balance, and close the project clean.

pricing.title: Simple, while we're early.
pricing.subtitle: One plan, everything included. Free for pilot studios during early access: no card, no lock-in.
pricing.sub: Then simple per-studio pricing. We'll talk before anything changes.

final.title: Run your next fit-out on Metra.
final.lede: Set up your studio in minutes and take your next project from concept to handoff, with the numbers under control.

meta.title: Run your interior design studio, from proposal to handover
meta.description: Every pound of a project's value, traceable from the line you quoted to the line you invoiced.

errors.forbidden: Your role in this workspace cannot do this. Ask an owner or admin to do it, or to change your role.
errors.generic: We could not finish this because of a problem on our side. What you entered is still here; try again in a moment.
errors.uncertain: We could not confirm your change was saved: the server was busy or the connection dropped. Refresh the page to check before trying again.
errors.check_fields: Some fields need fixing. Look for the message under each one.
errors.busy: Someone was changing the same record at that moment. Refresh the page to see the latest, then try again.
errors.market_book_busy: The market price book is being loaded or updated right now, so this request added nothing. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.malformed: This page sent something we did not expect. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.record_not_found: This no longer exists; someone may have deleted it. Refresh the page.
errors.logo_image_unsupported: This file cannot be used as a logo. Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image of 2 MB or less.
errors.storage_unavailable: We could not store the file right now. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, contact us.
errors.reference: If it keeps happening, send us this code: {reference}.
errors.unreachable: We could not reach Metra. Check your internet connection, then try again. What you entered is still here.

field.required: This is required. Fill it in to continue.
field.too_long: Too long. Keep it to {max} characters or fewer.
field.too_short: Too short. Write at least {min} characters.
field.not_a_number: That is not a number. Use digits, with a dot for decimals, like 1250.50.
field.not_negative: This cannot be below zero. Enter 0 or more.
field.email_format: That email does not look right. Write it like name@example.com.
field.no_longer_exists: That choice no longer exists; it may have been deleted. Pick another one.
field.unprintable: This has hidden or control characters. Clear it and type it again instead of pasting.
field.schedule_sum_mismatch: The rows add up to {actual}; they must add up to {expected}.
field.schedule_value_too_small: The contract value {value} is too small for this split. Use fewer payments or change the shares.
field.date_in_future: That day has not come yet. Pick today or an earlier day.

errors.file_too_large: That file is too large; the limit is 100 MB. Choose a smaller file or compress it.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: This file type is not accepted for this kind of file. Choose a file in one of the accepted formats.
errors.name_required: Write the name in Arabic or English; one of them is enough.
errors.last_owner: This is the last owner of the workspace. Make someone else an owner first, then try again.
errors.owner_immutable: Only an owner can change or remove an owner. Ask an owner to do it.
errors.self: You cannot change your own role or remove yourself here. Ask another owner or admin to do it.
errors.already_member: That person is already a member of this workspace. Change their role from the members list instead.
errors.pending_exists: An invitation to this email is already waiting. Resend it from the pending invitations instead.
errors.invite_expired: This invitation has expired; invitations last 7 days. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
errors.invite_wrong_account: This invitation was sent to a different account. Sign out, sign in with the email address it was sent to, then open this link again.
errors.invite_not_found: This invitation link is not valid; it may have been used or cancelled. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.
errors.otp_verify_failed: That code is wrong or has expired. Type the newest code we sent, or ask for a new one.
errors.otp_rate_limited: Too many codes were requested. Wait a minute, then ask for a new one.
errors.otp_sms_unavailable: We cannot send text messages right now. Sign in with your email instead.
errors.otp_email_unavailable: We cannot send email to this address yet. Sign in with your phone number, or contact us.
errors.immutable: This record is locked, so it cannot be changed. Refresh the page to see its current state.
errors.code_required: A code is required. Type a short code, like PB-101.
errors.code_taken: Another item already uses this code. Choose a different code.
errors.import_empty: The file has no rows to import. Check that it has a header row and at least one item, then upload it again.
errors.import_too_large: The file is too large or has too many rows. Split it into smaller files and import them one by one.
errors.import_unreadable: We could not read that file. Save it as CSV (comma separated) and upload it again.
errors.client_required: No client is selected. Pick one from the list, or add the client first.
errors.invalid_dates: The end date is before the start date. Pick an end date on or after the start.
errors.proposal_not_draft: This proposal was already sent, so it cannot be edited. Refresh the page to see its current state.
errors.draft_changed_elsewhere: This draft was changed in another tab or by someone else. Reload the page to get the latest version, then make your change again.
errors.draft_too_large: This draft is too large to save in one go. Split it into fewer lines or shorter descriptions.
errors.draft_incomplete: Every line needs a description and valid figures, and every section a name. The first one missing is selected.
errors.line_required: The document has no lines yet. Add at least one line.
errors.token_invalid: This link is not valid. Please ask the sender for a new link.
errors.token_expired: This link has expired. Please ask the sender for a new link.
errors.already_responded: A response was already recorded for this proposal. To change it, please contact the sender.
errors.discount_out_of_range: The discount is outside 0 to 100. Enter a percentage from 0 to 100.
errors.supervision_out_of_range: The supervision percentage is outside 0 to 100. Enter a percentage from 0 to 100.
errors.tax_out_of_range: The VAT rate is outside 0 to 100. Enter a percentage from 0 to 100.
errors.too_many_lines: This document has too many lines to save. Split it into two documents or remove lines you do not need.
errors.invalid_date: That is not a valid date. Pick a date from the calendar.
errors.date_in_future: That date is in the future. Pick today or an earlier day.
errors.amount_too_large: That amount is larger than Metra can hold. Check the number of digits and enter it again.
errors.last_primary_contact: This is the primary contact of the client. Make another contact primary first, then remove this one.
errors.contract_exists: A contract was already generated from this document. Open it from the contracts list.
errors.proposal_not_accepted: The proposal has not been accepted yet. Record the acceptance first, then generate the contract.
errors.contract_not_draft: This contract was already issued, so it cannot be edited. Refresh the page to see its current state.
errors.contract_not_issued: The contract has not been issued yet. Issue it first, then try again.
errors.contract_not_signable: This contract can no longer take this step in its current state. Refresh the page to see where it stands.
errors.variation_not_draft: This variation order is no longer a draft, so it cannot be edited. Refresh the page to see its current state.
errors.variation_not_internal_approved: The variation order is not approved internally yet. Approve it first, then issue it.
errors.engagement_title_required: The delivery has no title. Write one in Arabic or English; one of them is enough.
errors.engagement_client_required: No client is selected. Pick the client this delivery is for.
errors.engagement_project_required: No project is selected. Pick the project this delivery belongs to.
errors.engagement_not_found: This delivery could not be found; it may have been deleted. Go back to the deliveries list.
errors.engagement_not_active: This delivery is closed, so it cannot be changed any more. Open an active delivery instead.
errors.illegal_trigger: This step is not allowed from the current stage. Refresh the page to see the steps available now.
errors.engagement_state_conflict: This delivery was just updated by someone else. Refresh the page, then try again.
errors.guard_scope_inputs_missing: The delivery is missing its title, client or project. Add them, then continue.
errors.design_fee_required: No design fee is set. Enter a design fee greater than zero.
errors.milestone_split_invalid: The payment schedule does not add up or has no deposit. Include a deposit and make the parts add up to the fee.
errors.milestone_kind_duplicate: A milestone type appears more than once. Keep each type once and merge the amounts.
errors.payment_amount_invalid: The payment amount is missing or zero. Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.claim_not_found: This payment claim is no longer available; it may have been handled already. Refresh the page.
errors.claim_already_settled: This payment is already recorded in full. Dismiss the client's claim instead.
errors.claim_pending_for_milestone: The client says they paid this one. Confirm or dismiss their claim on the delivery first.
errors.deposit_not_cleared: The deposit has not been fully paid yet. Record the deposit payment, then continue.
errors.gate_a_not_cleared: The Gate A installment has not been fully paid yet. Record that payment, then continue.
errors.gate_b_not_cleared: The Gate B installment has not been fully paid yet. Record that payment, then continue.
errors.rom_not_acknowledged: The client has not acknowledged the build-cost range yet. Record the acknowledgement before approving the design.
errors.as_built_not_reconciled: The as-built variance is not reconciled yet. Reconcile it before approving the design.
errors.spatial_base_missing: There is no survey on this delivery yet. Record a survey (or a developer CAD set for off-plan), then continue.
errors.concept_options_out_of_range: A concept review needs 2 to 4 options. Upload between 2 and 4 options, then continue.
errors.revision_co_amount_required: This revision is beyond the free allowance. Enter a change-order amount greater than zero.
errors.revision_cos_outstanding: Revision change orders are still unpaid. Settle them before moving on.
errors.renders_missing: There is no approved render yet. Add at least one approved render to continue.
errors.as_built_not_due: As-built drawings are not part of this delivery. Skip this step.
errors.shop_drawings_missing: There is no shop drawing yet. Record at least one shop drawing to continue.
errors.boq_missing: There is no bill of quantities yet. Record the BOQ to continue.
errors.balance_not_cleared: The final balance has not been fully paid yet. Record that payment, then continue.
errors.handoff_not_acknowledged: The recipient has not acknowledged the handoff yet. Record the acknowledgement before closing.
errors.client_review_pending: The client has not answered the review yet. Wait for the answer, or record an offline approval.
errors.advance_unconfirmed: The payment is recorded, but we could not confirm the delivery moved to the next stage. Refresh the page, and if it is still waiting, press Advance to the next stage. Do not record the payment again.
errors.offline_approval_date_out_of_range: That date is outside this review. Pick a date between the start of this review and today.
errors.client_review_answered: The client answered the review in the meantime. Reload the page to see their answer.
errors.concept_option_not_found: That option is not released to the client. Choose one of the lettered options.
errors.delivery_link_unrecoverable: This client link cannot be shown again. Replace it to send a reminder.
errors.client_email_missing: The client has no email address on file. Add one to the client, or send the reminder on WhatsApp.
errors.reminder_email_failed: The reminder email did not go out. Try again, or send it on WhatsApp.
errors.delivery_link_not_shared: There is no client link yet. Share one with the client first.
errors.delivery_links_not_configured: Link reminders are unavailable until the server is configured. Ask your Metra administrator.
errors.reminder_too_soon: A reminder email went to this client in the last 15 minutes. Try again later.
errors.handoff_not_open: The design-only handoff is not open at this stage. Move the delivery to the handoff stage first.
errors.rom_range_invalid: The build-cost range is not valid. Enter a low and a high amount, with the low one first.
errors.rom_not_set: There is no build-cost range yet. Enter the range before recording the acknowledgement.
errors.rom_not_issued: The range has not been issued to the client yet. Issue it first, then record the acknowledgement.
errors.off_plan_locked: Off-plan can only be changed before the deposit is paid. Keep the current setting.
errors.flow_not_enabled: This flow is not part of your workspace plan. Contact us to add it.
errors.payment_kind_mismatch: This payment type does not match the step being advanced. Choose the payment type this step needs.
errors.ending_requires_explicit_choice: Choose the ending yourself: design-only handover or client will build.
errors.firm_type_unavailable: That firm type is not available yet. Choose Interior fit-out to continue.
errors.project_delivery_exists: This project already has an active delivery. Open it to continue.
errors.project_delivery_limit_reached: This project has already used its two deliveries. Create a new project to start another.
errors.phone_required: A phone number is required. Write one so the studio can reach them.
errors.start_date_required: A start date is required. Pick the day the project starts.
errors.project_limit_reached: Your plan has no project seats left. Contact us to add more.
errors.event_not_found: That record is not on this delivery; it may have been removed. Refresh the page.
errors.already_corrected: That record was already retracted. Refresh the page to see the current ledger.
errors.rom_already_issued: This range was already issued to the client. Refresh the page to see it.
errors.boq_not_draft: This BOQ was issued, so it can no longer be changed. Refresh the page to see the issued version.
errors.boq_not_found: That bill of quantities no longer exists; it may have been deleted. Refresh the page.
errors.boq_send_conflict: The BOQ changed while it was being sent or issued. Review it and try again.
errors.renderer_busy: The PDF service is busy right now, so nothing was sent or issued. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.proposal_is_boq: This is the delivery's BOQ. Send it from the delivery page.
errors.line_not_found: That line no longer exists. Refresh the sheet.
errors.section_not_found: That section no longer exists. Refresh the sheet.
errors.description_required: This line has no description. Write what the line is for.
errors.description_too_long: That description is too long. Shorten it, or split it over two lines.
errors.item_code_too_long: That item code is too long. Use a shorter code.
errors.invalid_unit: That is not one of the units Metra knows. Pick a unit from the list.
errors.invalid_qty: That quantity is not a usable number. Enter 0 or more, with digits and a dot for decimals, like 12.5.
errors.invalid_price: That rate is not a number. Use digits, with a dot for decimals, like 1250.50.
errors.invalid_discount: The discount is outside 0 to 100. Enter a percentage from 0 to 100.
errors.section_name_required: This section has no name. Write a name for it.
errors.section_name_too_long: That section name is too long. Use a shorter name.
errors.phone_invalid: That phone number does not look right. Write it with digits only, 7 to 15 of them.
errors.studio_phone_invalid: That number cannot be dialled as written. Write an Egyptian number with its leading 0, like 0223456789 or 01012345678, or + and the country code, like +442079460958.
errors.whatsapp_invalid: WhatsApp cannot reach that number. Write a mobile number: an Egyptian mobile, or the number with its country code, like +44.
errors.iban_invalid: This IBAN does not look right. Check it against your bank statement; it starts with two letters, like EG.
errors.bank_name_required: An account number or IBAN needs the bank name too. Add the bank name.
errors.account_number_invalid: This account number does not look right. Write 4 to 34 letters or digits, with at least one digit.
errors.client_page_details_owner_only: Only the owner or an admin can change what your clients see. Ask one of them to make this change.
errors.client_page_details_stale: Someone else changed these details while you were editing. Reload to see them, then make your change again.
errors.expected_date_out_of_range: That date is too far away or already past. Pick a date from today to a year from now.
errors.contract_not_execution: This works only for a contract generated from a BOQ. This contract came from a proposal.
errors.boq_not_issued: This BOQ is not issued, or a newer version replaced it. Issue the BOQ first, then generate the contract.
errors.boq_has_contract: A contract stands on the issued BOQ, so it cannot be replaced. Record later changes as change orders.
errors.delivery_not_in_execution: The delivery has not reached execution yet. Choose execution as its ending first, then generate the contract.
errors.contract_schedule_missing: The contract has no payment schedule yet. Add the schedule on the Schedule tab, then send the contract.
errors.contract_schedule_invalid: The payment schedule does not add up, or mixes percentages with amounts. Use one kind for every row and make the rows add up exactly.
errors.schedule_too_long: A payment schedule can have at most 12 rows. Merge some of them, then save.
errors.contract_not_signed: The client has not signed the contract yet. Wait for their signature, or record that they signed on paper.
errors.contract_not_active: This contract is not active, so nothing can be billed on it. Refresh the page to see its current state.
errors.request_exists: This payment request was already sent. Refresh the page to see it.
errors.request_not_found: That payment request no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.request_void: This payment request was voided. Refresh the page to see the current requests.
errors.request_has_payments: Payments are recorded against this payment request, so it cannot be voided.
errors.payment_exceeds_request: That is more than what is still due on this request. Enter {outstanding} or less.
errors.claim_pending_for_request: The client says they paid this request. Confirm or dismiss their claim first.
errors.variation_not_approved: The client has not approved this change order yet. Wait for their approval, then send the request.
errors.variation_credit_not_billable: This change order lowers the contract value, so there is nothing to bill. It reduces the final account instead.
errors.final_account_issued: The final account is already issued, so this can no longer change. Void the final account first if it has no payments.
errors.final_account_nothing_due: Nothing is left to bill: everything in the final account was already requested.
errors.final_account_changed: The final account changed since you opened it; it is now {amount}. Check the new figure, then issue it.
errors.open_variations: A change order is still waiting for a decision. Settle every open change order before the final account.
errors.cost_entry_not_found: That cost entry no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.cost_entry_voided: This cost entry was voided, so it cannot be changed.
errors.line_not_in_contract: That line is not part of this contract. Pick a line of this contract.

proposal.title: The proposal's headline, shown to the client. Leave blank to use the quote number.
proposal.discountPct: A document-wide discount applied to the subtotal before VAT.
proposal.taxRate: VAT rate applied to the taxable base (subtotal minus discount).
proposal.supervisionPct: Supervision fee charged after VAT, as a percentage of the taxable base. The client pays it.
proposal.sectionTitle: Name of this section. Pick a saved title or type a new one to add it to your library.
proposal.lineUnitPrice: Price charged to the client per unit, before any line discount.
proposal.lineUnitCost: Your internal cost per unit. Never shown to the client.
proposal.lineDiscountPct: A discount applied to this line only.

auth.email: We email you a one-time code to sign in. No password needed.
auth.otp: The 6-digit code we just sent you. It expires shortly.
auth.phone: We text you a one-time code to sign in. No password needed.

onboarding.orgName: Your company name, shown on quotes and to your team.

org.name: Your organisation's name, shown across the app and on client documents.
org.hideMarginFromPm: When on, project managers cannot see cost or margin figures.

account.displayName: The name teammates see next to your activity.

client.name: The client's name, in Arabic or English. At least one is required.
client.contactName: The person you usually deal with at this client.
client.email: Primary email for sending this client proposals.
client.phone: A contact phone number for this client.
client.address: The client's full address, shown on documents.
client.taxRegistrationNumber: The client's tax registration number, printed on invoices.
client.type: Whether this client is an individual, a company, or a consultant.
client.advancePct: Default advance payment percentage for this client's contracts.
client.retentionPct: Default retention percentage withheld on this client's contracts.
client.notes: Private notes about this client. Never shown to the client.

project.code: A short unique code for this project within your organisation.
project.name: The project's name, in Arabic or English. At least one is required.
project.client: The client this project belongs to.
project.type: The kind of project (villa, office, …). Pick one or add a new type.
project.description: A short description of the scope of work.
project.advancePct: Advance payment percentage agreed for this project.
project.retentionPct: Retention percentage withheld on this project's payments.

costItem.code: A short unique code for this item within your price book.
costItem.name: The item's name, in Arabic or English. At least one is required.
costItem.category: The trade or discipline this item belongs to.
costItem.unit: The unit this item is measured in.
costItem.defaultUnitCost: Your default internal cost per unit. Never shown to clients.
costItem.defaultUnitPrice: The default price charged to clients per unit.

priceBook.category: Limit the update to one category, or apply it to all.

boq.headline: Publish the bill of quantities

change_triage.headline: Settle the as-built variance
change_triage.sub: Attest the corrected drawings to bring the design back for approval.

execution_decision.sub: Nothing is blocked on you. The balance clears, then they pick design-only or execution.
